idea-plugin.name: DevSuperSuite - AST Context Slicer & Secret Shield
idea-plugin.description:
DevSuperSuite is a local-first systems utility running on native Tree-sitter grammars:
  • -83% Token Bloat: Slices 74,000-token monorepos down to 12,600 tokens in under 2.4ms per 1k LOC.
  • Shannon Entropy Gate: Intercepts unencrypted API secrets before git commit with 0.0% false alarms.
  • Test Invariant Protection: Prevents AI coding tools from deleting unit tests to fake passing builds.
  • 100% Localhost Air-Gapped: Zero telemetry, zero cloud tracking, runs completely offline.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release of DevSuperSuite for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and GoLand.
